data_output.description: The fixed training command writes predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids, an int64 array of canonical validation row positions in evaluator order, and scores, a one-dimensional finite float array of identical length aligned positionally with row_ids. No ground-truth labels may be included or loaded by training; ground truth is loaded only by the fixed evaluator.

model_input.description: Model(dimension, learning_rate, l2) must preserve the existing interface. It receives encoded train or validation feature matrices shaped (n, 2), with column 0 containing offset user indices and column 1 containing offset video indices, plus float labels only for training steps. Initialize user_embeddings and item_embeddings as float32 arrays shaped (user_dimension, 16) and (item_dimension, 16), respectively, from a reproducible normal distribution with mean 0 and standard deviation 0.01 using config['seed']; additive weights remain zero. Preserve logits, pointwise binary cross-entropy gradients, Adam controls, state/load_state, predict output shape, and all existing dimensions.
